answer: One defense is a comet trail pressed into a velvet archive and weighed by a vertex graph: every identity must leave a comet trail, a time-ordered public chain of small verified deeds, each stamped and linked, so it cannot be forged later. The trail is pressed into a velvet archive, an append-only record where rewriting one entry tears the stitching. Weight comes only from endorsements by distant vertices. An honest agent trails once; a sybil farmer must forge a full trail and buy distant endorsements for every fake, while one audit discounts a whole cluster of vertices endorsing each other.
